messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: PROD alert - service=sidebar-adapter namespace=ui severity=P2; 5xx rate >40% (2m). Alert link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/ALRT-9521
Alex R: grabbing logs & pods now
Alex R: `kubectl -n ui get pods -l app=sidebar-adapter` ->
```
  NAME                                READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
  sidebar-adapter-v2-6f7d8c9b4-abcde  0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   12         8m
  sidebar-adapter-v1-5b4c3d2f-xyz12   1/1     Running            0          3d
```
Alex R: `kubectl logs sidebar-adapter-v2-6f7d8c9b4-abcde` shows: `panic: missing env CONFIG_ADAPTER_V2` and stack trace
Maya L: rolled v2 as canary at ~11:58 UTC, manifest change added new container but I thought configmap mount was identical
Sam T: HPA is behaving weirdly - readiness failing so HPA sees restarts and scales up replicas, CPU low but restarts still spike
Jenna K: paging @Priya S for handoff :rotating_light:
Priya S: I'm oncall, taking it. what's the current mitigation plan?
Alex R: root cause looks like manifest dropped the env var reference for v2 (CONFIG_ADAPTER_V2). Plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop routing to v2 2) scale down v2 3) ensure v1 traffic restored 4) roll back manifest or patch configmap 5) follow-up postmortem
infra-bot: Suggested command: `infractl feature toggle --env=prod --feature=sidebar_adapter_v2 --state=off`
Priya S: I'll flip the feature flag and scale down. Doing feature toggle now.
Priya S: `infractl feature toggle --env=prod --feature=sidebar_adapter_v2 --state=off` (executed)
infra-bot: Feature flag changed: sidebar_adapter_v2 = OFF by Priya S at 2026-03-15T12:07:35Z
Priya S: scaling down v2 -> `kubectl -n ui scale deploy sidebar-adapter-v2 --replicas=0`
Priya S: `kubectl -n ui get svc sidebar-adapter -o yaml` shows only v1 endpoints now
Alex R: also running `kubectl rollout status deploy/sidebar-adapter-v1` to confirm readiness
Maya L: dashboard (link) shows 5xx rate dropping from 45% -> 4% within 90s of flag flip :thumbsup:
Sam T: HPA replicas dropping back to normal, no more CrashLoopBackOffs observed for v1 pods
Alex R: quick workaround branch created with configmap restore and tests + lint enforced. We'll open a PR for safe redeploy once validated
Priya S: Customer impact summary: errors observed 12:03-12:11 UTC, affected region: eu-west primarily, estimated ~0.8% of requests returned 5xx, CS notified to tag affected customers
Jenna K: informing top-10 customers now, adding note to incident channel
oncall-bot: (automated) Incident status changed to RESOLVED_PROVISIONAL; monitor for 30m
Priya S: handing off to Maya L for postmortem + follow-ups: create ticket for manifest validation gate, stricter deploy checklist, and add alert for missing env in deploy manifests
Maya L: ack, I'll own the postmortem and schedule RCA. Also will add a pre-deploy check in CI to diff required env keys against manifest
Alex R: logs snippet for root cause included for PM: `fatal: configmap key CONFIG_ADAPTER_V2 not found`
Priya S: final note - recommend feature-flag-only rollouts for adapter work going forward (small % traffic -> validate config -> increase). Closing thread unless new flares.
